reviews.reason: CodeTemplatesTab 拥有模板表和代码 studio，studio session 捕获 starting revision，后台刷新不覆盖未保存 source。 职责属于同一资源或组件生命周期，独立草稿/异步状态没有应合为单一字段的不变量；同步 setters 由 React19 batching，行数或 setter 数本身不能证明额外 render。 Reassessed 2026-10-29: The delta adds the dedicated routes tab and URL destination; existing code-template/component tabs retain their composition and ReactNode content slots.

RouteManagementContent owns one navigation-management screen. Query and mutation hooks own server state, NavigationMoveTree owns drag projection, and RouteNodeDrawer/MovePageModal own editors. moveError, editor, movingId, search and locatedId represent independently edited interaction axes; scope keys remount the screen across auth owners. Route tests retain failure/retry, readonly access, search, editing and pending-write behavior.

Autocomplete filters existing path/slug records before mapping survivors to value/label options. The tree and authoritative node order are retained separately; search neither filters the navigation Tree nor mutates backend records. The search scenario asserts locating descendants without removing/reordering other nodes.

The readonly visibility icon is intentionally focusable so keyboard users can open its Tooltip and read the visibility explanation. It exposes role=img with an aria-label, has no click/mutation action and does not claim button semantics. The readonly scenario asserts an indicator without a mutation operation.

role=status announces an ongoing save using translated text; role=img labels a composite Ant Design SVG visibility icon. The span wraps an aria-hidden child SVG and a Tooltip; it is not an external image resource that can be replaced with img src. No form calculation result is being rendered. The readonly route scenario protects its non-actionable status contract.
